summary.text: Doug Miller is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who represents District 48, assumed office on November 5, 2014, and is the incumbent in the November 3, 2026 general election for that seat.
Ballotpedia lists Emily Yaw (D) and Marshall Travis (G) as the other candidates on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Doug Miller was born and raised in Elkhart County, where he attended Concord High School and Goshen College.
He began his career as a homebuilder, eventually working at Tailor Made Homes, LLC, and owns Creekside Realty, LLC and White Pines Properties, LLC.

He sits on the board of directors of the Builders Association of Elkhart County, holds a life directorship at the Indiana Builders Association, serves as Indiana's representative on the board of directors of the National Association of Home Builders, and previously served on the Elkhart County Area Plan Commission and Plat Committee and chaired its Board of Zoning Appeals.
For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists Miller as chair of the Government and Regulatory Reform Committee and a member of the House Environmental Affairs and House Local Government committees.
